what: The hangar deck of DCS's Nimitz class carrier (CVN-71), from the models (catcc-dcs/deck-test/hangar/hangar_map.py). Ship coordinates: x metres forward of the ship's origin, z metres to starboard, heights above the origin.

physics floor, free from 0.15 to 4.8 m above it
legend.,: floor that is drawn but is not the physics', free likewise
legend.m: under a part that moves in the model (an elevator, a door, a rail)

grid.how: rows[r][c]: the cell whose corner is x0 + c * cell forward, z0 + r * cell to starboard (rows run from port to starboard); a row is cut where nothing more follows
